storyline.real: Prost leads from pole until the rain comes; he stays out on slicks and crashes on lap 29. Hill leads behind the safety car; Senna, in for wets on lap 27 and for slicks at the end of lap 40, takes the lead when Hill stops for slicks a lap later and wins by 16.6 seconds

hidden.label: Win with two tyre stops, as Senna did

eras.briefing: Interlagos, March 1993. Dry at the start: Prost leads from pole in the Williams, Hill second, Senna third in the McLaren. Rain is on the way. Pit boards only, no radio: every tyre call counts. Reconstructed race: no lap timing survives, so the laps are rebuilt from the results and race reports. Who led each lap is sourced, and so is the order at a few laps; the lap times, and the rest of the order, are reconstructed.
